meta.title: core: enhance log formatting in node
meta.body_summary: Adjust log formatting in src/utils.js to improve CircleCI output readability; PR closed immediately due to CI failure.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex attempted log formatting change but caused CI failure; author closed immediately.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 112 changed lines across 16 files, this is a small change by absolute volume, concentrated in a 27-line core utility edit plus merge from master. As a tiny logging format tweak, it was closed—not merged—because CI failed immediately upon opening.

review_details.concern_detail: Author commented that the CircleCI output clearly showed the change failed; no formal review was performed before closure.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve CircleCI output readability via log formatting.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by author immediately after CI failure was observed.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A one-line log formatting change in a JavaScript utility caused CI failure, possibly due to syntax or logic error; illustrates Agent's difficulty with even small code edits in a project with strict CI checks.

detection_detail.ci_auto: CircleCI run showed failure; author inspected output and closed the PR.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling evidence provided; author cited CI failure as reason for closure.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed without any fix attempt; no revert occurred as the PR was never merged.

core_change_summary.description: Modify log formatting in src/utils.js (22 additions, 5 deletions) with the goal of improving CircleCI output readability. The exact changes are not visible, but the aim is to format log messages for better console output.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All secondary changes were introduced by a merge commit bringing in unrelated upstream changes.
